briefing_summary_en: The eight-section briefing tracks open-weight trillion-parameter AI, enterprise agent tooling and OpenAI's Model Spec update; developer news includes Node.js 26 LTS, Vercel CI and LLM-generated tests. Science items report associations between sweeteners or light and cognitive risk, not causation. Startup funding includes Mintive and Upwind. World coverage spans US-Japan missile production, Ukraine drone attacks and a suspected record Binance hack; China coverage covers the plenum decision and a meteorological data space; finance shows a tech selloff and a bond haven bid, with BOJ signals supporting the yen. Opinion features technical essays and a death discussion.
